vocabulary.meaning_en: a helping verb (be, do, have, will) used with a main verb
vocabulary.example: In "I am eating", am is an auxiliary verb.

vocabulary.meaning_en: another name for an auxiliary verb
vocabulary.example: "Have" is a helper verb in "I have eaten".

vocabulary.meaning_en: an answer with only yes/no + subject + auxiliary
vocabulary.example: "Yes, I do" is a short answer.
"I did call you!" uses did for emphasis.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that something is true; to say yes
vocabulary.example: "Yes, I have" affirms that I ate.
He feigned interest in the story.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing you care about what someone says, to be polite

vocabulary.example: He answered in a matter-of-fact way.
Short answers are completely valid in English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the tense am/is/are + verb-ing for actions happening now
vocabulary.example: "I am going to the store" is present continuous.

fine_lines.title: full answer vs short answer
words: Yes, I do like ice cream.
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المبتدئون يكرّرون الجملة كاملة للتدريب، لكن المتحدثين الأصليين يكتفون بـ yes/no + الفاعل + الفعل المساعد. لا نكرر بقية الجملة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Beginners repeat the whole sentence to practise, but native speakers just say yes/no + subject + auxiliary. We don't repeat the rest.

examples.word: Yes, I do like ice cream.
examples.sentence: Do you like ice cream? Yes, I do like ice cream. (correct but long)
Do you like ice cream? Yes, I do. (natural)

fine_lines.title: That's nice. vs Are they?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: That's nice جواب عادي بلا مشاعر. أما ردّ الفعل المساعد + الضمير (Are they? / Is he?) فيُظهر اهتمامًا ومفاجأة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "That's nice" is plain, matter of fact. Auxiliary + pronoun (Are they? / Is he?) shows interest and surprise.

examples.sentence: Sam and Ali are moving to Dubai. That's nice.
Sam and Ali are moving to Dubai. Are they? Wow!

expressions.meaning_en: Short answer to a Do...? question.
expressions.example: Do you know the address? Yes, I do.

expressions.meaning_en: Short answer to a Have you...? question.
expressions.example: Have you had dinner? Yes, I have.
Have you finished? No, I haven't.

expressions.meaning_en: Shows interest in news about people.
expressions.example: My parents are visiting Japan. Are they? How exciting!
Omar is the new manager. Is he? Great!

grammar.title: General jobs of auxiliary verbs: action and time
grammar.explanation_ar: be + ing يدل على حدث يجري الآن (I am going). did للماضي والتوكيد (It did work). will للمستقبل (I will go). have + التصريف الثالث للربط بزمن آخر (I have gone).
grammar.explanation_en: be + -ing shows action happening now (I am going). did shows the past and emphasis (It did work). will shows the future (I will go). have + past participle connects to another time (I have gone).
examples: I am going to the store.

grammar.title: Short answers: yes/no + subject + auxiliary
grammar.explanation_ar: نجيب بنفس الفعل المساعد الموجود في السؤال: Do → do، Have → have، Are → am/are، Can → can. لا نكرر الفعل الرئيسي.
grammar.explanation_en: Answer with the same auxiliary as the question: Do → do, Have → have, Are → am/are, Can → can. Don't repeat the main verb.
examples: Do you like tea? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Have you eaten? Yes, I have.
Are you tired? Yes, I am.
Can she swim? No, she can't.

grammar.title: Showing polite interest: auxiliary + pronoun?
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يخبرك أحد بخبر، ردّ بالفعل المساعد + الضمير كسؤال قصير لإظهار الاهتمام: He is? / Are they? / Did she? / Have you?
grammar.explanation_en: When someone tells you news, reply with auxiliary + pronoun as a short question to show interest: Is he? / Are they? / Did she? / Have you?
examples: I'm learning Chinese. Are you? That's great!
Sara passed her driving test. Did she? Wonderful!
I've been to Canada. Have you? When?

questions.question: "Have you had dinner?" Short answer:
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال بـ Have فالجواب بـ have.
questions.explanation_en: The question uses have, so answer with have.

questions.question: "Do you know the address?" Short answer:
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال بـ Do فالجواب بـ do.

questions.question: Your friend says: "My brothers are moving to Canada." Show interest:
questions.explanation_en: The news uses are → Are they?

questions.question: "Sara passed her test." Show interest:
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل passed في الماضي → Did she?
questions.explanation_en: Passed is past simple → Did she?

questions.question: In "It did work!", did is used for ___.
"I've been to Japan." Show interest:
questions.explanation_ar: I've تعني I have، فنقول Have you?
